domain.text: GitHub API behavior for rolling learning PR submissions

impressions.text: The task addressed false failure reports when GitHub had accepted a branch update but the rolling PR head had not yet caught up.
The worker added bounded polling and a successful-but-not-yet-updated outcome, while preserving failure for a genuinely different head or a closed PR.
The worker reported tests for propagation lag, a different head, and polling exhaustion; the full test suite passed after the change.
The orchestrator reported CI green and confirmed the behavior for a real move and for a PR head that never catches up.
